text: Frame-time bound revised (lead, 2026-10-04) for headless Monocle software rendering. Measured over 8 runs at load 22–41: p99 21.7–86.9 ms, worst 28–145 ms. The test's acceptance is now: cell count ≤ 60 (virtualisation, the real property), median frame ≤ 32 ms, worst frame ≤ 250 ms, with the frame statistics printed on every run. Idle-machine, hardware-pipeline frame budgets are owned by S10.6 performance qualification.
